paraphrase: Seeing a rice seedling, the Buddha said: 'whoever sees dependent origination sees the dharma; whoever sees the dharma sees the Buddha', and fell silent; Maitreya explains dependent origination outwardly (seed, sprout, leaf) and inwardly (the twelve links and six elements), neither eternal nor annihilated.

original.text: yo bhikṣavaḥ pratītyasamutpādaṃ paśyati, sa dharmaṃ paśyati | yo dharmaṃ paśyati, sa buddhaṃ paśyati
